Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Pine Bar Cabinet, 31.5"W, Brown
Colors: Brown
Materials: Engineered Wood
This mid-century-style 2-door bar cabinet offers an understated but classic way to store your kitchen and bar supplies. It can easily fit in your kitchen or dining room, reducing clutter while adding a simple elegance. 31.5"W x 15.8"D x 39.4"H Pine and MDF with pine veneer This cabinet offers storage for your kitchen, bar, or dining room, with interior shelving for ample storage space. This bar cabinet sports a classic mid-century design that allows it to fit in any kitchen or dining room. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Using a soft, damp cloth, wipe in the direction of the grain. Free returns for 30 days; 1-year warranty.
